Keep the synthetic router small, then unwind the index and record the gate. When the matcher looks wrong, yield the portable record instead of the index.

When the cache looks wrong, refactor the measured hook instead of the corpus. The small vector only matters if the cache can rotate the shard on its own.

The boring vector only matters if the router can gather the queue on its own. Prefer a boring token over a clever corpus when you measure the cache.
